description: After delivering morning briefing, asked David to identify Speaker 2 from plaud-ingest recording instead of using available data sources (calendar, Obsidian MCP) to solve it. Violated 'don't ask unnecessary questions' principle.
what_was_wrong: Had sufficient context from briefing: calendar entry for podcast filming, description mentioning 'Saxon', 'Renzi', YPO connections. Should have searched calendar and Obsidian vault instead of requesting input.
what_should_have_happened: Use calendar to find podcast recording details, search Obsidian MCP for 'Saxon', 'Renzi', YPO member profiles. Cross-reference with Frank Murphy/Rain Stegen connections to identify Speaker 2.
proposed_fix: Before asking controller for factual information, exhaust available data sources: calendar, Obsidian (MCP only), delegation tracker, people files. Only ask if data sources return nothing.
impact: Interrupted controller's flow, created friction in boot workflow completion.
